items.summary: CRO handoff: retain four deferred, reversible opportunities for the next eligible queue slot; create no new queue work while failure-repair, measurement, release, security, ownership, and attribution gates remain open. 1) SEO content normalization using microsoft/markitdown (MIT; CRO lab 8/8 checks passed, dependencies not installed): prototype offline conversion of three existing source documents into review-only Markdown, then compare editorial QA time and later eligible-page impressions using existing telemetry. Learn in 1–2 cycles; rollback by deleting the generated artifacts. Risks: dependency/plugin provenance, malformed-document handling, and maintenance drift; require pinned review and security checks before adoption. 2) Reusable CTA/accessibility treatment using shadcn-ui/ui (MIT; CRO lab 3/3 checks passed): prototype one copied, dependency-free CTA/focus pattern in an isolated preview for a queue-ready site, with keyboard traversal, contrast, destination, disclosure, and build checks. Measure existing CTA clicks or sessions after an approved release; baseline and lift are unknown. Learn in one cycle; rollback the component diff. Risks: copied-source maintenance, accessibility regressions, and accidental destination/tracking changes. 3) Content diagrams using mermaid-js/mermaid (MIT; CRO lab fit supported but no native checks available): render one static, sanitized diagram in a preview of an evidence-backed guide or editorial explainer and test page weight, accessibility text, and build output. Measure existing search clicks, sessions, or engagement only after release; no lift is claimed. Learn in 1–2 cycles; rollback the inserted artifact. Risks: client-side bundle weight, unsafe user-controlled diagram input, and maintenance burden; prefer pre-rendered output and pinned versions. 4) Affiliate conversion-path repair: use the existing allthingsmasonic.com inspection artifact and registered tracking-ID evidence to identify only confirmed disclosure, destination, or CTA defects; do not infer a leak from 61 clicks, zero attributed orders, or zero attributed commission on 2026-09-21. Smallest prototype is one confirmed link/disclosure correction with deterministic crawl and disclosure checks, followed by existing-telemetry comparison. Learn in one measurement window; rollback only the bounded edit. Preserve aggregate affiliate earnings as unattributed and do not add monetization, credentials, spend, or telemetry. Reject Crawl4AI, MinerU, Strapi, Pathway, Ghost, and other trend candidates for now: popularity is not adoption evidence, lab/security/license/maintenance review is incomplete, and no smallest safe fleet-specific prototype is currently justified. created_by=cro.
